LanguageData.MegaMod_RestartNotice: When module toggles are changed, RimWorld must be restarted for active patches and architecture build menus to update.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ModulesDesc: Enable or disable SadSeal Mega Mod modules. Disabled modules will skip Harmony patching and hide associated build menus.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ModuleCombat_Desc: Ballistic accuracy curve, projectile speed, lethality, and armor penetration enhancements.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ModuleSkills_Desc: Learning speed multipliers, daily XP cap toggle, and skill decay settings.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ModuleRecipes_Desc: In-game real-time editor for recipe ingredients, work amounts, and crafts.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ModuleGenes_Desc: Synthesize any xenogerm gene in the Gene Assembler using Neutroamine.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ModuleHauling_Desc: Efficient multi-item hauling utilizing colonist inventory pockets.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ModuleWorkManager_Desc: Intelligent automated colonist work priority assignment based on skills and passions.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ModuleDurability_Desc: Disable apparel and weapon wear, tainted clothing overrides, and gear restoration.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ModuleQoL_Desc: Filth cleanup, non-flammable metals, tree lifespans, death acidifier removal, and raid tweaks.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ModuleMedical_Desc: Field medicine, smart medicine selection, and autopsy organ harvesting.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ModuleAllowTool_Desc: Haul Urgently, Select Similar, Unforbid All, and Finish Off designators.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ModuleTimeFlow_Desc: 4x speed button, smart sleep auto-fast-forward, and combat slow-down controls.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ModuleQuarry_Desc: Excavate rock chunks, steel, plasteel, components, and precious resources.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ModuleAutoArm_Desc: Automatically upgrade colonist weapons to superior equipment from stockpiles based on tier hierarchy.
LanguageData.MegaMod_RecipeDesc: In-game real-time recipe editor for vanilla and all modded RecipeDefs. Customize ingredient lists, work amounts (crafting time), names, or disable recipes completely.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ResetAllConfirm: Are you sure you want to revert all custom recipe tweaks to vanilla defaults? This will erase all your saved recipe modifications.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ResetAllSuccess: All recipes have been reset to vanilla defaults.
LanguageData.MegaMod_RecipeHelp: Tip: Edits made in the Recipe Editor take effect immediately and are saved automatically across game restarts.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Recipe_SelectFromLeft: Select a recipe from the list on the left.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Recipe_DeleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete custom recipe '{0}'?
LanguageData.MegaMod_Recipe_CannotResetCustom: Custom recipes have no default state. Use 'Delete Recipe' to remove it.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Recipe_ErrNoProduct: Please select a product to make.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Recipe_ErrInvalidWork: Please enter a valid work amount (positive number).
LanguageData.MegaMod_Recipe_ErrNoWorkbench: Please select at least one workbench.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Recipe_ErrNoIngredients: Please add at least one ingredient.
LanguageData.SLM_OnlyColonists_Desc: When enabled, multipliers and benefits apply exclusively to player colonists and faction members.
LanguageData.SLM_DisableDailyCap_Desc: RimWorld penalizes learning speed by 80% after gaining 4,000 XP in a day. Enabling this removes that penalty entirely.
LanguageData.SLM_DisableSkillDecay_Desc: Prevents skills above level 10 from losing XP over time.
LanguageData.SLM_MuteMasterworkLegendary_Desc: Disables the loud letter sound effect and popup letter envelopes when colonists craft or construct Masterwork and Legendary quality items.
LanguageData.SLM_UseGlobalMultiplier: Use Global Multiplier for All Skills
LanguageData.SLM_UseGlobalMultiplier_Desc: When checked, the global slider applies to every skill. Uncheck to configure each skill independently.
LanguageData.SLM_IndividualNotice: Note: Global multiplier is currently active. Uncheck 'Use Global Multiplier' above to apply individual values.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_EnableAccuracy_Desc: Replaces vanilla's harsh distance penalty with a ballistic curve, making skilled shooters deadly at long range.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_FalloffMult_Desc: Higher values reduce accuracy at extreme ranges.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_DamageMult_Desc: Increases raw damage dealt by ranged projectiles.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_ApMult_Desc: Increases bullet armor penetration, making armor quality crucial.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_SpeedMult_Desc: Increases projectile travel velocity for snappier gunplay.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_MeleeDamageMult_Desc: Multiplies base damage for all melee attacks and weapons.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_MeleeApMult_Desc: Multiplies armor penetration for all melee attacks and weapons.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_EnableStagger_Desc: Bullets slow incoming targets regardless of pawn body size.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_StaggerSpeedFactor_Desc: Target move speed while staggered (lower = heavier slow).
LanguageData.LethalRanged_Prevent1Hp_Desc: Removes vanilla's artificial rule that forces vital body parts to survive with 1 HP when taking fatal single hits.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_AffectTurrets_Desc: When checked, defensive turrets also benefit from the improved ballistic formula.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_SettingsDesc: Configure the Neutroamine cost, crafting work duration, and requirements for synthesizing custom genepacks at the Gene Assembler.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_InstantCraft_Desc: When enabled, the genepack is produced immediately once Neutroamine is loaded into the assembler without requiring pawn labor.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_AllowArchite_Desc: Allows archite genes to appear and be craftable in the Gene Synthesizer.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_RequireArchiteCapsules: Require Archite Capsules for Archite Genes
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_RequireArchiteCapsules_Des: Requires colonists to load Archite Capsules in addition to Neutroamine for archite genes.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_GizmoSynthesizeDesc: Open the Gene Synthesizer dialog to choose and craft genes or ready xenotype presets in exchange for Neutroamine.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_GizmoCancelDesc: Cancels the active synthesis order and safely unloads any loaded Neutroamine.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_GizmoClearAllDesc: Cancels all queued synthesis orders and unloads any loaded Neutroamine.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_GizmoDevFinishDesc: Instantly completes the current gene synthesis.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_Finished: Gene synthesis finished: created genepack with {0}.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_XenotypeFinished: Gene synthesis finished: created combined xenotype genepack for {0}.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_SelectGenePrompt: Select a gene from the list to view details and begin synthesis.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_SelectXenotypePrompt: Select a xenotype preset to preview constituent genes and enqueue crafting orders.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_QueueEmpty: The synthesis queue is currently empty. Select a gene or xenotype preset to enqueue orders.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_QueueCombinedDetails: Combined pack with {0} genes • Cost: {1}x Neutroamine
LanguageData.SadHaul_ModDesc: Intelligent gathering system that allows colonists to collect multiple haulable items into their inventory on a single trip before delivering and unloading them at storage.
LanguageData.SadHaul_Enable_Desc: When enabled, haulers automatically gather nearby eligible items along their route into inventory before walking to storage.
LanguageData.SadHaul_DropOnDraft_Desc: Instantly drops only gathered hauling items when drafted for combat, preserving weapons, personal gear, food, and medicine.
LanguageData.SadHaul_StrictClustering_Desc: Only gathers items that share the exact same target stockpile or storage shelf settings as the primary haul target.
LanguageData.SadHaul_Animals: Allow Pack Animals to Smart Haul
LanguageData.SadHaul_Animals_Desc: Enables smart multi-item gathering for trained hauling animals and colony beasts of burden.
LanguageData.SadHaul_Radius_Desc: Maximum distance (in tiles) around the primary item to search for additional haulables.
LanguageData.SadHaul_MaxItems_Desc: Maximum number of extra item stacks a pawn may gather into inventory per hauling job.
LanguageData.SadHaul_MassLimit_Desc: Maximum percentage of the pawn's carry capacity to fill before ending gathering and heading to storage.
LanguageData.WorkManager_ModDesc: High-performance, automated priority and schedule management. Intelligently scores pawns by skill levels, passions, traits, and physical capacities to assign optimal work priorities and balanced schedules with zero TPS lag.
LanguageData.WorkManager_EnableWorkManager_Desc: Master switch for automated work priority and schedule assignments.
LanguageData.WorkManager_ManagePriorities_Desc: Automatically assigns manual 1-4 work priorities based on colonist aptitude and colony needs.
LanguageData.WorkManager_ManageSchedule_Desc: Optimizes 24-hour colony timetables into balanced shifts for rest, work, and recreation.
LanguageData.WorkManager_UseDedicatedWorkers_Desc: Ensures dedicated specialists (Doctors, Cooks, Researchers, Wardens, Handlers) are assigned high priority while leaving general chores to others.
LanguageData.WorkManager_UsePassionPriorities_Desc: Gives priority bonuses for burning passions (+30) and minor passions (+15) so colonists do what they love.
LanguageData.WorkManager_AssignWorkToIdlePawns: Assign Idle Colonists to Haul & Clean
LanguageData.WorkManager_AssignWorkToIdlePawns_Desc: When a colonist has no active jobs and goes idle, automatically elevates Hauling and Cleaning to keep them productive.
LanguageData.WorkManager_SupportNightOwls_Desc: Assigns inverted nocturnal shifts to pawns with the Night Owl trait to maximize mood bonuses.
LanguageData.WorkManager_PriorityInterval_Desc: Frequency in game ticks between automatic priority evaluations (500 ticks ≈ 8.3s at normal speed).
LanguageData.WorkManager_ScheduleInterval_Desc: Frequency in in-game hours between timetable re-evaluations.
LanguageData.WorkManager_RefreshedMsg: Work Manager: Priorities and schedules updated across all colonies.
LanguageData.WorkManager_GlobalEnabledTip: Work Manager is active. Click to pause automatic management.
LanguageData.WorkManager_GlobalDisabledTip: Work Manager is paused. Click to enable automatic management.
LanguageData.WorkManager_UpdateNowTip: Force recalculate priorities and schedules immediately.
LanguageData.WorkManager_ColumnPriorityHeaderTip: Automated Priority Management\nToggle per colonist to include or exclude them from automatic priority updates.
LanguageData.WorkManager_ColumnScheduleHeaderTip: Automated Schedule Management\nToggle per colonist to include or exclude them from automatic timetable updates.
LanguageData.WorkManager_PawnPriorityEnabledTip: {0}: Automatic work priorities enabled. Click to disable.
LanguageData.WorkManager_PawnPriorityDisabledTip: {0}: Automatic work priorities disabled. Click to enable.
LanguageData.WorkManager_PawnScheduleEnabledTip: {0}: Automatic schedule enabled. Click to disable.
LanguageData.WorkManager_PawnScheduleDisabledTip: {0}: Automatic schedule disabled. Click to enable.
LanguageData.MegaMod_DurabilityDesc: Disable durability (Hit Points) consumption for weapons and apparel at the zero-tick engine level. Generates zero tick overhead and causes no TPS drop.
LanguageData.MegaMod_RemoveApparelDurability_Desc: Disables the durability system for all apparel and armor. Items will not wear out, deteriorate, or take combat damage. Engine-level zero-tick architecture ensures zero performance impact.
LanguageData.MegaMod_RemoveWeaponDurability_Desc: Disables durability for all ranged and melee weapons. Weapons will never take damage from use or environment.
LanguageData.MegaMod_RestoreExistingOnLoad: Restore Existing Items on Load / Spawn
LanguageData.MegaMod_RestoreExistingOnLoad_Desc: Automatically restores damaged weapons and apparel to 100% condition whenever they are loaded or spawned.
LanguageData.MegaMod_PreventTaintedApparel_Desc: Prevents apparel from being marked as tainted/worn by corpse when pawns die.
LanguageData.MegaMod_RestoreGearOnlyInGame: This button can only be used while playing an active save to restore map and inventory items.
LanguageData.MegaMod_RestoredGearCount: Successfully restored {0} damaged items to 100% condition.
LanguageData.MegaMod_DurabilityPerfNote: ⚡ Zero-Tick Performance Architecture:\nThis mod manipulates core RimWorld ThingDef engine flags (useHitPoints = false) rather than relying on per-tick Harmony hooks or background loops. Even with 10,000+ items on the map, there is absolute zero TPS drop.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLDesc: Comprehensive collection of essential quality-of-life enhancements, pawn behavior improvements, base conveniences, and configurable raid options.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLUghYouGotMe_Desc: Ends social fights peacefully as soon as either participant experiences severe pain (>50%) or serious injury, preventing fatal or dismembering brawl outcomes.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLUghYouGotMeStopped: {0} and {1} stopped fighting before things got out of hand.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLWhereIsMyWeapon_Desc: When a downed colonist recovers, automatically queues an equip job to pick up their previously dropped primary weapon if it is accessible.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLPrioritizeSleep_Desc: Allows right-clicking any valid bed to order a colonist to rest until rested if their rest need is below 75%.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLDontBlockDoors_Desc: Prevents items from being hauled or stored directly onto door tiles, keeping passages clear.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLMetalDoesntBurn_Desc: Removes flammability from Steel and Plasteel walls, structures, and items, making metal structures properly fireproof.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLFilthVanishes_Desc: Causes outdoor filth to be rapidly washed away by precipitation, and old filth to naturally dissipate over time.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLStackableChunks_Desc: Allows stone chunks and slag chunks to stack up to the configured limit, saving massive storage space.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLTreesDontDie: Trees Don't Die of Old Age
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLTreesDontDie_Desc: Prevents wild mature trees from rotting and dying of old age, preserving beautiful forests and wood reserves.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLPrettyPreciousMetals_Desc: Significantly increases the ambient beauty provided by unworked Gold and Silver, making valuable ore stockpiles aesthetically pleasing.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLNoJobAuthors_Desc: Allows any qualified colonist to continue working on unfinished crafting, smithing, or tailoring items started by someone else.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLSmoothWallsBeforeFloors_Desc: Ensures construction workers prioritize smoothing rough rock walls before smoothing floors.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLRepairInZone_Desc: Prevents repair workers from leaving their assigned allowed area to repair damaged structures outside the zone.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLHaulAfterSlaughter_Desc: Automatically queues a hauling job for the handler immediately after slaughtering an animal to deliver the fresh meat to storage.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLDisableBreachRaids_Desc: Prevents hostile factions from initiating mining/sapper breach raids that demolish base perimeters.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLDisableDropPodRaids_Desc: Prevents hostile drop pods from crashing directly into the center of your base or through roofs.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLNoDeathAcidifiers_Desc: Prevents Empire and advanced raiders' death acidifiers from disintegrating weapons and armor upon death, leaving gear intact.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLTraderAlerts_Desc: Displays a prominent on-screen alert whenever a trade caravan or orbital trade ship is present and available for trade.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AlertTraderDesc: A trade caravan or orbital trade ship is available for trading with your colony. Don't forget to trade before they leave!
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLEnableRoofSafety_Desc: Prevents colonists from deconstructing or mining supports when doing so would trigger a roof collapse on a colonist or worker.
LanguageData.MegaMod_RoofSafety_Prevented: Roof safety prevented {0} from removing {1}: this would cause a roof collapse on a colonist!
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLEnableReplaceStuff_Desc: Allows placing blueprints over existing structures of the same category (e.g. stone wall over wood wall, door over wall) and smoothly replaces them without dropping roofs.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLEnableShareTheLoad_Desc: Allows multiple colonists to concurrently haul required construction materials to the same unfinished blueprint or frame instead of locking it to one worker.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLEnableCleanBeforeWork_Desc: Orders workers to quickly sweep and clean filth in kitchens and surgery/hospital rooms before starting cooking recipes or medical operations.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLEnableAutoCutBlight_Desc: Automatically designates crops for cutting the exact moment they become blighted to prevent outbreaks from spreading across fields.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLEnableSnapOut_Desc: Allows social colonists and wardens to attempt to calm down fellow colonists suffering from non-violent mental breaks.
LanguageData.MegaMod_SnapOut_Success: {0} successfully calmed down {1} from their mental break!
LanguageData.MegaMod_SnapOut_Failed: {0} attempted to calm down {1}, but could not reach them this time.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QoLEnableBillQoL_Desc: Adds bill clipboard copy/paste between workbenches, and automatically suspends production bills when required ingredients are missing.
LanguageData.MegaMod_BillAutoSuspended: Bill '{0}' on {1} was auto-suspended: required ingredients are missing.
LanguageData.MegaMod_BillAutoResumed: Bill '{0}' on {1} was auto-resumed: required ingredients are now available.
LanguageData.MegaMod_CopyBills_Desc: Copy all production bills from this workbench to the clipboard.
LanguageData.MegaMod_PasteBills_Desc: Paste compatible copied bills from the clipboard onto this workbench.
LanguageData.MegaMod_CannotPasteBills: Clipboard bills are not compatible with this workbench.
LanguageData.MegaMod_DurabilityPerfNote: ⚡ Zero-Tick Performance Architecture:\nThis mod manipulates core RimWorld ThingDef engine flags (useHitPoints = false) rather than relying on per-tick Harmony hooks or background loops. Even with 10,000+ items on the map, there is absolute zero TPS drop.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Medical_Desc: Advanced post-mortem organ extraction, combat field medicine, and smart medicine tier management.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Medical_EnableAutopsy_Desc: Allows colonists to perform surgical autopsies on fresh humanlike and mechanoid corpses at butcher tables or medical spots.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Medical_AutopsyBaseChance_Desc: Baseline probability to successfully extract viable natural organs and parts without damaging them.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Medical_AutopsyBionicChance_Desc: Probability of successfully salvaging bionic limbs and internal implants installed in the deceased.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Medical_ExtractMechParts_Desc: Allows disassembling mechanoids for high-grade steel, plasteel, and industrial components.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Medical_SoftenMood_Desc: Reduces the negative thoughts colonists suffer from harvesting or autopsying corpses.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Medical_MoodMultiplier_Desc: Set to 0% to completely eliminate penalties, or 20-50% for realistic balanced debuffs.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Medical_EnableField_Desc: Doctors will treat wounded pawns directly where they fall instead of carrying them all the way to a hospital bed first.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Medical_FieldDocInv_Desc: Doctors will prioritize medicine they carry in their own pockets.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Medical_FieldPatInv_Desc: Allows doctors to tend using medicines found in the patient's own inventory.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Medical_EnableSmart_Desc: Intelligently chooses medicine tiers based on severity of injury rather than blindly burning expensive medicine.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Medical_NoGlitterScratches_Desc: Doctors will never consume valuable Glitterworld medicine for harmless scratches or minor bruises.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Medical_SaveBestLethal: Reserve Best Medicine for Lethal Wounds
LanguageData.MegaMod_Medical_SaveBestLethal_Desc: Saves top medical supplies for life-threatening blood loss, severe infections, or emergency surgery.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Medical_BleedThreshold_Desc: Bleed rates above this value will trigger priority usage of advanced medicine.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AutopsySuccess: {0} successfully autopsied {1} and salvaged {2} viable organs/items.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AutopsyMechanoidSuccess: {0} dismantled mechanoid {1} and recovered {2} components and resources.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AutopsyFailed: {0} performed autopsy on {1}, but organs were damaged or ruined.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AllowTool_Desc: Essential map utility designators: unforbid all, haul urgently, select similar, and mercy finish off.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AllowTool_EnableUnforbid_Desc: Unlock forbidden items via drag box or one-click entire map unforbid.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AllowTool_EnableHaulUrgently_Des: High-priority hauling designator integrated seamlessly with Smart Haul.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AllowTool_EnableSelectSimilar_De: Select all identical items, resources, ores, or buildings on screen or across the map.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AllowTool_EnableFinishOff_Desc: Quickly and humanely dispatch downed incapacitated enemies or creatures.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Designator_Unforbid_Desc: Remove forbidden status from items in the selected area. Right-click to unforbid the entire map.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Designator_UnforbidAll_Desc: Unforbid all visible items across the map in a single click without having to drag an area.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Designator_HaulUrgently_Desc: Designate items for immediate emergency hauling before they deteriorate or rot.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Designator_SelectSimilar_Desc: Click any item to select all similar items on screen. Right-click to switch to entire map.
LanguageData.MegaMod_SelectSimilar_Gizmo_Desc: Select all matching items of this type on screen.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Designator_FinishOff_Desc: Designate a downed hostile or creature for quick humane execution.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Designator_StripArea_Desc: Designate all corpses and downed hostile pawns in the selected area to be stripped.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Designator_CancelArea_Desc: Cancel all work orders, construction blueprints, and designations in the selected area.
LanguageData.MegaMod_TimeFlow_Desc: 4x Super Speed without dev mode, prevention of forced combat slowdowns, and smart sleep fast-forward.
LanguageData.MegaMod_TimeFlow_UnlockSuperSpeed_Desc: Enables the 4x ultrafast speed button in the main UI and enables the '4' hotkey without needing Developer Mode.
LanguageData.MegaMod_TimeFlow_DisableForcedSlowdown_D: Prevents raids, combat, and damage events from forcibly dropping game speed to 1x.
LanguageData.MegaMod_TimeFlow_SmartSleep_Desc: Automatically switches time speed to maximum when all colonists are sleeping and no dangers exist, restoring normal speed upon waking.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Quarry_Desc: Buildable quarry structure for mining stone chunks, steel, plasteel, uranium, and machinery components.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Quarry_InfiniteQuarry_Desc: When checked, the quarry can be mined indefinitely without depleting subterranean resources.
LanguageData.MegaMod_Quarry_MiningSpeed_Desc: Adjusts how quickly colonists complete excavation bills and gain mining skill.
LanguageData.MegaMod_QuarryDepleted: Deep quarry has been completely excavated and depleted of resources.
LanguageData.SadQuarry_MineChunks_Marble_Desc: Excavate marble stone chunks from the quarry floor.
LanguageData.SadQuarry_MineChunks_Granite_Desc: Excavate granite stone chunks from the quarry floor.
LanguageData.SadQuarry_MineChunks_Slate_Desc: Excavate slate stone chunks from the quarry floor.
LanguageData.SadQuarry_MineChunks_Limestone_Desc: Excavate limestone stone chunks from the quarry floor.
LanguageData.SadQuarry_MineChunks_Sandstone_Desc: Excavate sandstone stone chunks from the quarry floor.
LanguageData.SadMedical_AutopsyResearch_Desc: Learn surgical dissection and organ preservation methods. Allows constructing dedicated medical autopsy tables to salvage organs, bionics, and implants from fresh corpses.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AutoArm_Desc: Colonists periodically inspect stockpiles and shelves to automatically upgrade to better weapons within their assigned weapon class.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AutoArm_Enable_Desc: Allows colonists to automatically search for and equip better weapons.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AutoArm_OnlyStockpile_Desc: When enabled, colonists will only pick weapons stored in stockpiles or shelves, ignoring unhauled ground loot.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AutoArm_AutoSkill_Desc: Unarmed colonists will automatically be assigned an optimal weapon category based on traits (Brawler) and Shooting/Melee skills.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AutoArm_ConsiderQuality_Desc: Scales weapon score by quality (Masterwork and Legendary weapons receive substantial score boosts).
LanguageData.MegaMod_AutoArm_ConsiderHP_Desc: Weapons below 50% hit points suffer a score penalty to encourage swapping to durable gear.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AutoArm_UnforbidDropped_Desc: Automatically unforbids the replaced weapon so haulers can immediately haul it back to storage.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AutoArm_MinDiff_Desc: The new weapon must be at least this much better than the current one to justify equipping it.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AutoArm_Interval_Desc: Frequency in seconds with which colonists re-scan stockpiles for weapon upgrades.
LanguageData.MegaMod_AutoArm_Tier1_Desc: Pistol < Bolt-Action Rifle / Bow < Sniper Rifle / Charge Lance
LanguageData.MegaMod_AutoArm_Tier2_Desc: Autopistol < Heavy SMG < Assault Rifle < Minigun / LMG
LanguageData.MegaMod_AutoArm_Tier3_Desc: Knife < Shortsword < Longsword < Monosword / Plasma (Plasteel bonus)
LanguageData.AutoArm_GizmoDesc: Auto-Arm: Automatic weapon upgrade settings. Click to switch or lock weapon category.
